notes: Mt Adams hilltop; sheet drawn rotated (north arrow ~45 deg right of page-up). CELESTIAL (50') comes NE from the left margin to Monastery, takes SIDEREAL (20', T at its north end; south end at the steps), then on its SSE/SE/south legs takes GEROME ST. (50') and FILSON PL. and reaches HILL at the bottom. Hill is offset at Celestial as on sheet 127: the 50 ft east part (north face y~4395-4407, south face off the bottom edge) runs east past St. Gregory and Perpendicular Alley; the 40 ft west part only shows its north face. MONASTERY (40') runs ESE from Celestial past the IDA wooden bridge to a junction at (2652,1016) where ST. PAUL (FAGIN) PL. (30') comes in from the SW; from that junction a 30 ft street (30' printed at both ends) runs SSE to St. Gregory along the west side of the Mt. Adams Public School block. That leg carries no name on this sheet; it is recorded as Monastery Street because it continues Monastery's line (Monastery lots run to 1037 at the corner) - uncertain. St. Paul Place: SW of about (1300,2350) it continues as 30 ft WOOD STEPS down to Celestial's east side (the stub seen on sheet 127 at (3080,1700)); steps not recorded as a street. PAVILION: the big label on this sheet reads PAVILLION, but the lot labels here and sheet 129 spell it PAVILION; recorded as Pavilion Street so it joins across sheets. Pavilion (40') runs from St. Paul Place (west leg, lots labelled PAVILION, width 40 printed beside the 386 elevation) SE across St. Gregory, takes BELVEDERE (40'), GUIDO (CHURCH) (30') and FULLER (40'), and leaves the right edge at about (3870,3640). ST. GREGORY: 40' NE of Pavilion (straight to the right edge), 50' SW of Pavilion and on the page-south leg to Hill. Top right: E. COURT (60') runs ESE from the Ida bridge (passes under it, not recorded) and ends at an unlabelled 60 ft street that runs NNE to the top edge; that street is Elgin Place (Eden Park Ct.) on sheets 129/143 (the 310 elevation sits in this junction on both 128 and 129). HATCH (40') leaves Elgin at the pipe corner and runs SE; the Hatch/St. Gregory centreline crossing falls about 20 px beyond the right paper edge, so it is not recorded. An unnamed 15 ft strip runs east from Perpendicular Alley at y~3655-3707 to the right edge (recorded as alley). A narrow (~4 ft) passage runs SE from St. Gregory's east side at y~2720 to Guido: footway, not recorded. WOODEN STEPS between St. Gregory lots at y~3745: not a street. Scale ~3.44 px/ft.
